description: Listeners object to restrictions on choosing, skipping, and replaying specific songs, especially when these controls are limited to encourage a Premium subscription.
name: Song selection and playback controls

description: Reviews give a broad negative judgment of the app or its update without identifying a specific problem.
name: General dissatisfaction

description: The app crashes, fails to load, or does not start playback as expected, including through Google Assistant.
name: App startup and playback failures

description: Listeners report missing songs or limited availability of particular genres, as well as inconsistent lyrics coverage.
name: Missing music and content

description: Users complain that basic listening controls are restricted to Premium subscribers, describing the changes as an unwanted push to pay.
name: Paid-plan restrictions

description: Users cannot access their accounts, including problems signing in or having a password accepted.
name: Account access and sign-in

description: Downloads get stuck or offline listening does not work reliably.
name: Downloads and offline listening

description: A review expresses dissatisfaction with Spotify’s support stance without describing a specific support interaction.
name: Support-related dissatisfaction
